nodes.description: Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates delegate, init, batchSend, _mints and setTradeAddress.
Public balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping set by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply fixed in the constructor.
Whitelisted trading address used by ensure; writable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Whitelist flag mapping consulted by ensure and set by _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address allowed, set in init, read in condition.
Minimum transfer amount, set in init, enforced in condition.
Maximum transfer amount, set in init, enforced in condition.
Constant token decimals (18) used as a scaling factor in _mints, init and the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address compared against in ensure as a privileged caller.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Public payable ERC20 transfer that simply forwards msg.sender to transferFrom.
Internal whitelist/privilege check comparing _from/_to with owner, UNI, tradeAddress, a computed pair address and canSale.
Public payable transfer entry point performing unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic and the ensure() gate.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit validation reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker/owner supplied address.
Privileged mint function that sets balanceOf[spender] from addedValue and whitelists the address in canSale.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer using unchecked multiplication for the total and unchecked balance updates.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure.
Deploys the token: sets owner=msg.sender, supply, balances and infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
SafeERC20 private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call to a token and decoding the optional return data.
External caller identity used for authorization, allowance indexing, approvals and as default sender.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): owner-controlled arbitrary code execution with this contract's storage/context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked subtraction).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath after a non-atomic require.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked addition / infinite mint risk).
uint total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath (overflow).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop performed without SafeMath.
address(token).call(data) low-level external call inside callOptionalReturn that can re-enter the caller.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates all state changes to transferFrom.
Parameter _to flows from transfer into transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows from transfer into transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and indexes allowance, gating who may spend funds.
msg.sender selects the allowance slot that is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath after a non-reentrant-safe check.
transferFrom adds to balanceOf[_to] with unchecked addition.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance state variable.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf state mapping.
transferFrom calls ensure() before moving balances.
Parameter _from of transferFrom drives allowance and balance updates.
Parameter _to of transferFrom receives the credited balance.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is the unchecked amount applied to balances.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without any bound check.
ensure compares _from and _to against the privileged owner address.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition checks.
ensure treats tradeAddress as a privileged sender that bypasses condition().
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address compared against _from.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) via require for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure parameter _from is compared against the whitelist addresses.
ensure parameter _to is compared against owner.
ensure parameter _value is forwarded into condition().
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether sales are enabled.
condition enforces _minSale against the transfer amount.
condition enforces _maxSale against the transfer amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition parameter _from indexes the _onSaleNum counter.
condition parameter _value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall, letting the owner execute any code in this contract's storage context.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target controlled by the owner.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata passed to delegatecall.
delegate reads the owner state variable for authorization.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner and a hardcoded address whitelist.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue scaled by decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting transfer bypass privileges.
Parameter spender receives minted balance and whitelist status.
Parameter addedValue is scaled by decimals and written to balanceOf.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum.
init parameter saleNum is stored in _saleNum.
init parameter token scales into _minSale.
init parameter maxToken scales into _maxSale.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend computes uint total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend adds _value to each balanceOf[_to] inside the loop without SafeMath.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
Parameter _tos determines the loop recipients and the unchecked total.
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited per recipient.
Unchecked multiplication result is assigned to the local total.
Local total feeds the unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
Loop-local _to is taken from _tos and credited in batchSend.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist bypass entry.
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints the initial supply to the deployer.
Constructor assigns the privileged owner role from msg.sender.
Constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor grants the Uniswap router an infinite allowance.
Constructor sets the immutable totalSupply.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
approve writes the allowance state mapping.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter token is the external contract targeted by the low-level call.
Parameter data is the arbitrary calldata executed by the low-level call.
callOptionalReturn performs an arbitrary external low-level call that can re-enter the calling contract before state is finalized.
Local success holds the low-level call outcome used by the require.
Local returndata is optionally abi.decode'd as a bool result.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used to forward into transferFrom from transfer.
_value is only used to forward into transferFrom from transfer.
_from is the primary subject of the ensure whitelist comparison.
_to is compared against owner inside ensure.
_value is forwarded from ensure into condition.
_from indexes allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom.
_to indexes the credited balanceOf entry inside transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
a is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
b is the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
spender receives the minted balance and canSale flag.
addedValue is scaled by decimals and written to balanceOf.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
token is scaled into _minSale by init.
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init.
_tos supplies the loop recipients and the unchecked multiplier in batchSend.
_value participates in the unchecked multiplication and credits in batchSend.
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
token is the low-level call target in callOptionalReturn.
data is the low-level call payload in callOptionalReturn.
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication and is subtracted from the sender balance.
loop-local _to exists only to receive _value inside batchSend.
success only carries the outcome of the low-level call inside callOptionalReturn.
returndata is only consumed within callOptionalReturn.
